column2: [15] Bowels of the Beast

As the M.I. flag is raised over the center of Federatsiyagrad, reports indicate that the Arachnids have established an elaborate network of tunnels and colonies below the city's surface.

Before total victory can be declared, our troopers must venture underground and carry out a thorough cleansing of the remaining bug infestation.

Damn, it stinks to high hell down here.
Consider the aroma an incentive to finish this quickly. We can’t hold the city while bugs keep popping up from below ground.
Command wants all these tunnels cleared out. Do a full sweep.
Let’s move. We’ll rendezvous with the other squads along the way.
What am I stepping in right now?
If it makes you feel better, that’s mostly industrial wastewater. Only a small percentage is raw sewage.
I’ll still take sewers over bug caves any day. At least human tunnels come with a map.
Maintenance bay’s dead ahead.
Bravo team got overrun there. Survivors have barricaded themselves in.
Clear the bay and open the gate to make contact.
Bugs have been busy, they’re expanding the tunnels.
Destroy every nest down there or we’ll have to do this all over again.
Fry those nests! Use flamethrowers, grenades, loose matches… just get to work!
And keep your eyes open – all hell is going to break loose real soon.
Control has remotely sealed that stairway. The bugs won't be getting out through there any more.
We've detected the main bug force is on the move. Significant numbers are coming your way.
They'll be heading for the metro exit. They cannot be allowed to escape!
Great work. Even Bugs don't want to suffer those kind of losses. The survivors are retreating back into the sewers.
The bugs’ hold on the city has been broken. Good work, Major
You’re certain about that?
Psychics are always certain.
Too many have escaped! They've slipped through your fingers.
Seismics have detected a large number of bugs moving in your direction.
Mostly drones, but some larger types as well.  Seems to be preparation for an attack against the surface.
We’ll stop them down here, before they can hit topside.
Set up defenses. Ready the kill zone.
Use those ammo stashes to get some defenses set up. We'll give those Bugs a warm welcome.
Motion trackers detect additional bug attacks coming in.
We've got another squad of combat engineers on the way.
Looks like they're holed up in the Metro system. Clever - they can hide but still move around the city.
Mass transit is the fastest way to travel, even for bugs.
All friendly teams are down. Abort the mission.
